svg.text: Mockup 1 · the card and its wing
The family row: what orbits Earth, as captioned wells inside the card. They were
the buttons hanging off the bottom edge.
The hinge. Pressing Station unfolds a wing from the planet's card, inside one
frame. Earth stays in view and lit.
The wing has its own title, art, readouts and actions. The trade code and prices
are on it; yellow marks what buys your cargo.
Actions are pictured wells in the card, one word each. Fixed slots, keys 1–5.
One main action, here Trade. The first well goes back to Earth.
Earth's own actions dim while the wing is open; empty slots keep their places.
The last slot is always Details.
Minerva: the network in one place. Session and scans are her line; a move on its
Two buttons where there were four: Objects (everything here) and Map, with its
The pilot plate in two halves: you (your profile) and the ship you're in.
The strip stays as the short form; its list button opens Objects. The nearby
